# Alexey Konyakhin

Fractional CPO for founder-led software companies with paying customers and an in-house development team. Alexey helps when the team ships but the business priority keeps slipping. The founder sets the direction. Alexey works with the team to decide what comes first, what can wait and how to measure the result.

## Engagement

A paid first month comes first: agree the business problem, look at the evidence the company already has, and set one priority with clear owners and a practical plan. If it fits, the work continues month by month as fractional CPO: priorities, trade-offs, dependencies across product, engineering and operations, and keeping every team tied to the goal the founder set. When the numbers say something should not be built, he says so. Baseline and success criteria are set up front; at each checkpoint the engagement continues, changes scope, or finishes with a clean handover. Days per week and scope are agreed individually.

Alexey owns product priorities, trade-offs and delivery within the agreed budget. He tracks progress against the founder’s goal. The founder or CEO owns the direction, business goal, budget and access, and decides when any of those change. The CTO and team own technical quality, estimates and day-to-day execution. For example, if the goal is checkout completion, Alexey can defer a dashboard request so the team can fix failing payments. A change of budget or goal goes back to the founder. The scope excludes unlimited development, round-the-clock availability, an agency team, or guaranteed results.

- Based in Belgrade, Serbia, on Central European Time.
- EU and UK first. US East Coast mornings also work.
- Working languages: English and Serbian.
- Invoicing in EUR from a registered business in Serbia.

## Work

### Employee app for a major retail chain

Head of product for the whole app (retail, Russia). Alexey owned the product: priorities, research, delivery and measurement. He led developers, a designer and QA, and brought hypotheses and decisions to senior stakeholders. The app had more than 300,000 monthly active users during his time on the product. Apple had started rejecting the app as employee-only, while store reviews showed people downloading it in the hope of finding a job. Alexey proposed and led a hiring feature that opened one part of the app to everyone: a job application form that anyone could fill in, so candidates for cashier and store roles could apply directly. The rest of the app stayed for employees only. That was enough for Apple to accept it as a public app, and about 20,000 candidate applications came in over its first three months.

He led the team's implementation of the full analytics stack: event coverage in Firebase, a pipeline into BigQuery, and custom Looker dashboards that gave senior managers visibility into how the workforce used the app. He also shaped an employee's idea into an in-app learning game on existing training content and piloted it across 16 operational clusters.

### Copix, mobile printing network

Product work with the founding team (Russia, 2024 to 2026). Website: https://copix.app/. Alexey worked with the team on the mobile customer journey, refunds for failed prints and the feedback loop from support back into product. Between April 2024 and June 2026, monthly card turnover grew about 3 times and turnover per active printer grew 2.15 times. These are network-wide results during the collaboration, alongside pricing and network changes.

## Background

Alexey has worked in product and engineering since 2013 and founded or co-founded three companies between 2015 and 2022.

- 2025 to now: CPO, commercial real-estate platform.
- 2024 to 2026: Product work with Copix, mobile printing network.
- 2023 to now: COO and product lead, Erasoft.io.
- 2022: Senior Project Manager, Improvado, international team.
- 2020 to 2022: Founder, LTVCAC.agency, performance marketing and JTBD research.
- 2017 to 2019: Co-founder, Togezzer, internal comms for distributed teams.
- 2015 to 2017: Co-founder, Knedlik Tech, travel mobile app.
- 2013 to 2015: PM and tech lead, Globus, mobile and web portfolio.

## Products

Alexey also builds his own products: NicePass (https://nicepass.cc/), a Wallet pass restaurant guests get in 30 seconds, built to bring them back; VPNKill (https://vpnkill.com/), a packet-level VPN kill switch for macOS, free on the Mac App Store; and Rostok (https://rostok.dance/), a tool for dance teachers that keeps lessons, students and progress in one place, before launch.
